newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson Multimedia to be recapitalised.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Multimedia to be recapitalised.

text.p: French Industry Minister Franck Borotra said on Wednesday that consumer electronics company Thomson Multimedia (TMM) would receive a capital injection in the coming weeks.

He declined to comment on the amount of the injection and whether it was in line with an original plan for an 11 billion franc ($2 billion) injection into TMM's parent Thomson SA, which was part of a plan to privatise the company.
Borotra said he expected a decision on the sale terms of the state's 60-percent stake in defence electronics company Thomson-CSF would be taken before the end of January.

"To separate the sale of Thomson-CSF and Thomson Multimedia was a good thing. Thomson-CSF has to become the heart and the engine of the restructuring of the defence electronics and professional electronics sector," Borotra said at a new year's reception for reporters.

Borotra declined to comment on newspaper reports that he was privately in favour of a stock market flotation of Thomson-CSF. He said all options for the sale had advantages and disadvantages and the government was carefully studying them all.
